pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with the knight on f3; plan 3 sent a knight to f8 with the bishop there. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Maróczy Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted a rook Rf1-f3-g3 before castling. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Maróczy Variation, Maróczy Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 3 lifted a rook Rf3-g3 that isn't on f3; plan 1 used an e-file closed by White's e4-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: 3.Nd2 dxe4
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Ng3-f5 with no knight on g3; plan 2 used a queenside majority Black doesn't have; plan 3 read e5 as a move. Rewrote plans 1-3 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once as vague, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 3...Bf5
pages.notes: Plan 4 played Nh4 with no knight on f3; plan 3 put a knight on f6, which the e5-pawn covers. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed a knight ...Nd7-f8-g6 with the f8-bishop at home. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed a knight ...Nd7-f8-g6 with the f8-bishop at home. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2 c5 6.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote an ambiguous Nd2-f1-g3. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer: Nbd2-f1-g3 and Nh4 rejected as unconfirmed, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2 c5 6.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Nxd4 before ...cxd4; plan 4 castled with the f8-bishop still at home. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Advance, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2 c5 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Nc6 with no knight able to reach c6; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.
